description: Work a story with no test-first step: do the change, verify it against the acceptance criteria, commit, close out.

story.description: the story bead this formula works

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Run whatever {{story}}'s acceptance criteria say to check, and confirm it passes.

steps.title: Commit
steps.description: Commit the change for {{story}} in small, plainly described commits, with no AI attribution lines.

steps.title: Closing comment
steps.description: Comment on {{story}} with what was done, what was verified and how, and anything left undone. END the closing comment with a section headed exactly 'For the rig memory:' holding at most two short lines that a later Builder on this rig would have been saved real time by, or the single word 'nothing'. The Builder does NOT edit the rig memory file: the Mayor places what he keeps.
